<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 114.06808 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives an exact neutral mass of ~113.0608 Da. The formula C6H9O2 has a calculated exact mass of 113.06025 Da, which matches the observed neutral mass within experimental error, making C6H9O2 the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
